parsed.title: Discussion on AI in Job Search, Development, and Recruitment

topics.title: Using AI to automate job search and resume generation

claims.text: The user plans to set up an OpenClaw system to find vacancies, generate resumes, and write cover letters.
Automation with PDF resume generation is seen as better because humans can still analyze the document during technical interviews.
AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, LLM, RAG, Embeddings) are considered essential skills for 2026 job markets.
AI-driven job search may eventually make the recruiter profession obsolete.
AI can dramatically accelerate development by generating code such as SQL queries, but may produce insecure or inefficient code.
Relying on AI-generated code can lead to poorly optimized queries and security risks in production.

topics.title: Perception of recruiters and AI's effect on hiring

claims.text: Recruiters are criticized for not reading resumes and forgetting to attach them to job postings.
Search for candidates using AI-related keywords is considered detached from reality.
Developers use GPT to generate join queries, reducing routine work and speeding up development.
Even without cloud infrastructure, AI can speed up development tasks.
Quality of AI responses is often proportional to the quality of the question and available knowledge.
The current stack is likened to REST, JSON, Microservices, Docker after React.
